content.value: A mass of 5 kg is supported by a spring of stiffness 5 kN/m. In addition, the motion of mass is controlled by a damper whose resistance is proportional to velocity: The amplitude of vibration reduces to $^ { 1 } / _ { 1 5 } ! \mathrm { h }$ of the initial amplitude in four complete cycles. Determine the damping force per unit velocity and the ratio of the frequencies of the damped and undamped vibrations.
